facts.text: I filmed Santa on my camera. Tonight I'm leaving cookies by the tree and keeping the camera running.
facts.why: The plot summary has Kate and Teddy setting a tripwire and hidden camera together, and later 'Kate's video' of the adventure. Teddy filming Santa himself is not shown, so the note puts the camera on the wrong child.
facts.fix: Kate and I set a tripwire and hid the camera. There are cookies by the tree and the camera's running.

facts.why: The plot says Kate and Teddy set up a tripwire and hidden camera together, and the finished footage is called Kate's video. It does not say the camcorder is Teddy's.

facts.text: Snacking while Teddy's camcorder runs all night.
facts.why: The camera is a hidden one set up by both kids, so it is not Teddy's alone. They fall asleep in the living room while it waits.
facts.fix: Snacking while the hidden camera runs all night.
